summary: Synchrony Financial filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of 500,000 depositary shares representing a 1/100th interest in its 7.250% Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series C. The filing details the terms of the preferred stock and the associated Deposit Agreement. No price per share, premium, or other deal terms are disclosed. The board recommendation, advisors, and any strategic rationale are absent. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a preferred stock offering—not a special situation. The registrant acted solely as issuer of new securities.
